name: Beer City Metal Works & Construction
old_description: Beer City Metal Works is West Michigan's leading metal fabrication and custom miscellaneous metal works company. From architectural metal works, stair railings, custom furniture and fixtures to custom signage, bar tops, shelving and ornamental metals. BCMW does it all.
about:
Beer City Metal Works & Construction operates from Grand Rapids, Michigan, at 3925 Linden Avenue SE. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. General Manager Jon Counterman and Lead Fabricator Jon lead the team, though the firm does not identify them as founders in its materials.

The shop provides metal fabrication, custom signage, and ornamental metals, producing architectural metalwork, stair railings, custom furniture, fixtures, bar tops, and shelving. It offers design support from napkin sketch through CAD drawing to full 3D rendering, handling projects from concept to completion. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not published.

Beer City Metal Works serves commercial construction, working with top general contractors across the Midwest. Its miscellaneous metals packages support contractors needing fabricated components, while custom projects range from signage to ornamental installations for a variety of commercial clients.

The company emphasizes communication as its differentiator, stating that its team is dedicated to being better than the rest in project communication. It positions itself as the metal shop clients wish they had found earlier, focusing on responsiveness throughout the project lifecycle.
